inputs.name: sourceRoot
inputs.description: Repository-relative source root; "." or "./" selects the repository root.

inputs.name: glossary
inputs.description: Glossary path excluded from a repository-root migration scope; no model reads it.

inputs.name: exclude
inputs.description: Repository-relative source globs intentionally outside this migration.

inputs.name: quarantine
inputs.description: Exact source paths explicitly selected by an operator for evidence-preserving quarantine.

inputs.name: archiveRoot
inputs.description: Excluded archive root for explicitly quarantined legacy pairs.

inputs.name: branches
inputs.description: Branches on which an operator may start the migration.

inputs.name: branchPrefix
inputs.description: Prefix for the single draft migration pull request branch.

inputs.name: toolkit
inputs.description: Trusted deterministic migration transaction, report and M3 publication allowlist.
